changes_made.explanation: Added PERSPECTIVESUMM as the main benchmark dataset. Normalized model names to standard formats. Removed duplicate/variant model names and consolidated to canonical forms. IQ2 was normalized to Intelligence Squared Debate.
Removed duplicate metric entries (BUR, UER, AUC, SOF were already listed with full names). Kept all seven distinct automatic metrics used in the paper.
The paper does not use LLMs as judges to evaluate outputs after generation. LLMs are used only as generation models. Removed placeholder 'None' values.

changes_made.explanation: Added missing human evaluation criteria and consolidated guideline descriptions. The paper clearly describes two-stage human evaluation with detailed annotation procedures.

overall_notes: The paper is well-focused on NLG evaluation for abstractive summarization fairness. The extracted metadata was generally accurate but needed normalization and consolidation of model names. The paper introduces a novel benchmark (PERSPECTIVESUMM) and four new fairness metrics. Human evaluation is comprehensive with clear guidelines. No LLM-as-judge evaluation is used - LLMs are only used for generation.
